As you may be aware, the global financial crisis has severely
affected the developed markets and its impact is expected
to hit the African continent within this financial year. This

BOARD CHANGES
During the year, changes at the executive level took place
in our company. Mr. Mugo Kibati, Managing Director,
resigned in May and was replaced by Mr. George C.
Mwangi on December 9th, 2008. I take this opportunity
to thank Mr. Kibati for his efforts in steering the company
and wish him success in his future endeavours. I wish to
welcome on board Mr. Mwangi with full confidence that
he will continue to steer the company and maintain the
leadership position both locally and in the region.
